content: Recent clinical trials comparing intermittently scanned continuous glucose monitoring (isCGM) with real-time continuous glucose monitoring (rtCGM) have shown that rtCGM provides more significant improvements in time in range (TIR) and better management of hypoglycemia. One large non-randomized study specifically observed that adults with Type 1 diabetes who used rtCGM experienced greater glucose stability and a reduction in episodes of low blood sugar compared to those using isCGM. Overall, rtCGM is associated with higher adherence to treatment protocols and greater user satisfaction. This is largely attributed to its ability to provide real-time glucose data, which enables users to make immediate and informed adjustments to their diabetes management.
